stack.merge: only exact alias-normalized display identity with equal cost, description, modifier, and slot metadata; never fuzzy

wholeRow.storedQty: ignored and omitted on authoritative return

serialized.revision: increments exactly once across equip, return, swap, give, take, inventory transfer, and re-equip
serialized.activity: durable active/inactive/suppressed/broken state and exact reasons
serialized.configuration: reviewed definition-hash-bound equipment configuration or null

extraction.stackToEquipment: decrement exactly one stack unit and allocate one deterministic serialized identity
extraction.wholeRowToEquipment: remove exactly one row and allocate one deterministic serialized identity
extraction.serializedToEquipment: remove the whole row, preserve identity and state, increment the item revision
extraction.returnToInventory: preserve identity, canonical hashes, configuration, activity, and state in one non-mergeable row and increment the item revision

authority.inventoryCas: owning Trainer sheet or group-inventory revision
authority.equippedCas: owning sheet, equipment-state, and item-instance revisions
authority.setupAutosave: cannot create, rewrite, move, duplicate, or delete existing server-owned serialized state
authority.playerProjection: omits serialized identity, hashes, configuration values, and item-specific state

transfers.stack: move requested positive quantity; preserve row metadata; merge only under the exact stack policy
transfers.serialized: move exactly one whole row; preserve serialized identity, hashes, configuration, activity, and state while incrementing its revision exactly once
transfers.sourceRowId: container-local identity may change at destination without changing serialized whole-item identity

chargedAndDurableTools.activation: state is mechanically inert unless a reviewed item definition and ticket-specific reducer interpret it

failurePolicy.metadataMismatch: keep separate or reject; never discard source metadata
